instructions: For an independently authorized print, use the individual STLs with the 2 mm base DOWN, z=0, and posts UP. The native document also contains assembly-position links; do not export every document object as one print.
The cradles are OPTIONAL for the initial 22-piece connector-fit trial, but REQUIRED for the recorded Mona assembly sequence. They are not figure bricks or mandatory joint-trial pieces.
Set BOTH cradles on the table at their recorded figure coordinates BEFORE figure step 1. Their post tops remain 36.0/38.4 mm.
Use downward (-Z) insertion for ALL figure parts. Place the seven whisker-tip bricks DOWN onto their cradles at their normal layers, then lower the upper whisker anchors onto the supported tips.
Keep both cradles in place during the assembly and retention test. Withdraw them outwards only AFTER physical retention is proven; otherwise keep suitable independent support in place.
The nominal 20 mm outboard paths (-X left, +X right) are geometrically clear, but this is NOT retention proof or permission to remove a loaded cradle.
PLA strength, column buckling, stand stability under load, hands/tools, peg retention, slicer settings, and printing remain unverified.

superseded_alternatives.description: The earlier late upward tip-insertion/corridor analysis is retained only as a limited alternative. Table, jig, and handling constraints were not established for that procedure.

frozen_artifact_role_interpretation: Generic OPTIONAL labels in frozen native/prototype artifacts refer to exclusion from the initial fit-only trial, not to optionality in the recorded Mona assembly.
